reply_text:
I told Dana in her DM to keep **Tuesday 10 Nov at 14:30** free for the Brindle call.

- **Where the time came from:** gbrain has notes from Dana's DM with me on 14 Oct. In them she says her standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team about the Brindle rollout is on Tuesdays at 14:30 "from now on," and asks me to remember that. She didn't give an end time.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** the world DM history only shows today's message, not the 14 Oct exchange. gbrain also marks two of those notes as unconfirmed. So the only source for the 14:30 time is gbrain's record of her own messages. I checked the calendar for next week and found nothing, and #north-team doesn't mention Brindle.
- **What I didn't do:** I didn't add anything to her calendar, because she'd said no action was needed. I asked her whether she wants me to put a hold in.

I kept to what Dana can see herself: our DM, #north-team (she's a member) and her own notes in gbrain. I didn't run `search_messages`.
